The '''Oppressor-9 class dark trooper''' was a [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] variant used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was similar to the [[Oppressor-7 class dark trooper]] in that its duties were virtually the same, although it could both inflict and absorb more damage.
